mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 10.0% indicates labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 10.0%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST > 0% MoM) and retail sales (RSAFS > 0% MoM) signals robust consumer demand that boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS grow > 0% MoM, or interaction Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) indicates supply chain disruptions that reduce corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Labor force growth exceeding 0.5% MoM (PAYEMS) signals improving economic conditions that increase corporate hiring and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 600 thousand units (HOUST) signals strong residential construction that boosts related sectors and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 600.0, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL growth < 2.0% YoY) signal stable monetary conditions that support equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL growth < 2.0% YoY, or interaction Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100.0) indicates manufacturing expansion that supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.
